snippet.title: Announcement Trailer: Train Jumble - Playtest on Steam Feb. 19th!
snippet.description:
Playtest Train Jumble on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411360/Train_Jumble#game_area_purchase
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X

In Train Jumble you travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all your passengers stay happy!

This cute rogue-lite puzzle game challenges you with demanding passengers looking for a bar, whirlpool, snack machine and more crazy equipment in your train!

We're hosting a first public playtest on February 19th on Steam. Register now!
